== Description ==
Hi everyone! Our Spring update is almost and it comes with a lot of new and exciting additions to Hay Day! We have a new production machines, crops, products, a new type of decoration, a new Derby, and so much more! 

► Subscribe to my channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCggI6SgUa76JBQPohw-Ep5A
► Join my Discord server ➼  https://discord.gg/tQy6qnk

★ DON’T FORGET TO WRITE IN THE COMMENTS "What do you think about the new update?"

★ HAY DAY ➼ Hay Day is the best farming game ever created. It is developed and published by Supercell. Every player unlocked various stuff at different stages of the game. The Supercell team makes special seasonal updates. On the channel you can find all information about Hay Day, you need. I will upload videos about tips and tricks, updates an news or literally hanging out on the farm.
